sentences.en: Embassies are located in capitals.
sentences.zh: 大使馆都设在首都。

sentences.en: That's true all around the world.
sentences.zh: 世界各地都是如此。

sentences.en: And Israel is in a tiny category of having an embassy that is not in the capital.
sentences.zh: 而以色列属于极少数大使馆不在首都的国家之一。

sentences.en: And the reason for that is that Jerusalem is essentially a city divided.
sentences.zh: 原因在于耶路撒冷本质上是一座分裂的城市。

sentences.en: You've got West Jerusalem, which is the capital or the de facto capital of Israel, where all the government ministries lie, the prime minister's office, the Knesset.
sentences.zh: 你有西耶路撒冷，它是以色列的首都或事实上的首都，所有的政府部门、总理办公室、议会都在那里。

sentences.en: And then you've got East Jerusalem, which has mostly Arab-Palestinian neighborhoods and really functions as a separate city.

sentences.en: And a city which, because of its symbolic and historic role, is one that the Palestinians aspire to be the capital of their future state.

sentences.en: So this is an eternally contested city.

sentences.en: Back in 1917, the British controlled Palestine and they promised the Jews a homeland here.

sentences.en: But the Palestinians and the neighboring Arab countries rejected partition.

sentences.en: And by removing it, by saying, OK, that's settled, I'm going to move the embassy, he can actually make the process less cumbersome and clearer.

sentences.en: So to your point, this seems like an incredibly fraught situation into which the United States has just thrown a wrench.

sentences.en: Well, I think that's right.

sentences.zh: 安迪当时也在吸引亲以色列的支持者，特别是拉斯维加斯赌场大亨谢尔顿·阿德尔森，对他们来说，耶路撒冷的地位也是一个核心问题。

sentences.en: Remember, Sheldon Adelson is a major donor and has been a major donor to Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 记住，谢尔顿·阿德尔森是一位大金主，过去一直是唐纳德·特朗普的大金主。

sentences.en: And so he, in a sense, made a promise to both of these groups.
sentences.zh: 所以从某种意义上说，他对这两群人都做出了承诺。

sentences.en: They both came through for him in a big way in the presidential campaign.
sentences.zh: 他们在总统竞选中都对他的支持力度很大。

sentences.en: I love Israel.
sentences.zh: 我爱以色列。

sentences.en: I love Israel.
sentences.zh: 我爱以色列。

sentences.en: I've been with Israel.
sentences.zh: 我一直和以色列在一起。

sentences.en: There are all sorts of very good political reasons that have very little to do with international politics.
sentences.zh: 这里有各种各样非常好的政治原因，与国际政治几乎没有什么关系。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·罗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听 The Reframers，这是一档专注于设计之爱及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you,
sentences.zh: 甚至在我还在黑胶唱片时代去夜店打碟的时候，你每天都要带着 300 件你最珍贵的藏品去上班，

sentences.en: and you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把 DJ 台变成了一个美丽的 50 年代工艺品的活体快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自 Audemars Piguet 的 The Reframers。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费探索《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你就可以。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能得到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用并获得 30 天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Back now with new fallout from the firestorm gripping Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 现在我们继续关注席卷好莱坞的轩然大波的最新进展。

sentences.en: Movie mogul Harvey Weinstein taking a leave of absence from his own company after reports of multiple sexual harassment complaints against him.
sentences.zh: 电影大亨哈维·韦恩斯坦在面临多起性骚扰指控的报道后，决定离开他自己创立的公司。

sentences.en: Now police in New York and the UK both launching investigations into allegations of sexual assault.
sentences.zh: 目前，纽约和英国的警方均已对性侵指控展开调查。

sentences.en: In the two months since my colleagues Jody Cantor and Megan Toohey first reported on allegations of sexual assault by Harvey Weinstein,
sentences.zh: 在我的同事乔迪·坎托和梅根·图伊首次报道哈维·韦恩斯坦的性侵指控后的两个月里，

sentences.en: dozens and dozens of women have come forward with their stories about the Hollywood producer.
sentences.zh: 成百上千名女性站出来，讲述了她们与这位好莱坞制片人有关的经历。

sentences.en: Two more women have now come forward.
sentences.zh: 又有两名女性站了出来。

sentences.en: And five more made similar claims in London.
sentences.zh: 伦敦也有五名女性提出了类似的主张。

sentences.en: More than 60 women have accused Harvey Weinstein of sexual misconduct.
sentences.zh: 已有60多名女性指控哈维·韦恩斯坦存在性行为不端。

sentences.en: The notion of an open secret, the scale of the allegations, and the decades they spanned have raised another question.
sentences.zh: “公开的秘密”这一概念、指控的规模以及长达数十年的时间跨度引发了另一个问题。

sentences.en: Why, though, did it take so long for all of this to come forward after decades' worth of allegations?
sentences.zh: 然而，为什么在经历了长达数十年的指控后，所有这一切花了这么长时间才曝光？

sentences.en: I mean, I am genuinely shocked that you can get away with this.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我真的很震惊你竟然能逃脱惩罚。

sentences.en: I don't know how you could for so long, but clearly...
sentences.zh: 我不知道你怎么能瞒这么久，但显然……

sentences.en: It's an open secret in Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 这是好莱坞公开的秘密。

sentences.en: How did he get away with it for so long?
sentences.zh: 他是怎么逍遥法外这么久的？

sentences.en: Jody and Megan, you've turned your focus in recent weeks to how this could have happened and who else was involved.
sentences.zh: 乔迪和梅根，最近几周你们将重点转向了这怎么可能发生以及还有谁参与其中。

sentences.en: What have you found?
sentences.zh: 你们发现了什么？

sentences.en: So what we found is that Harvey Weinstein, for decades, cultivated powerful relationships with individuals and institutions
sentences.zh: 我们发现的是，几十年来，哈维·韦恩斯坦与个人和机构建立了牢固的关系，

sentences.en: that ended up serving as instruments or shields for his behavior.
sentences.zh: 这些关系最终成为他行为的工具或保护伞。

sentences.en: We looked at his relationship with media organizations that were supposed to cover him, but in some cases cozied up to him instead.
sentences.zh: 我们调查了他与本该监督他的媒体机构的关系，但在某些情况下，他们反而去巴结他。

sentences.en: We looked at his relationships inside the company.
sentences.zh: 我们调查了他在公司内部的关系。

sentences.en: There were executives and lawyers that sometimes helped cover it up.
sentences.zh: 有些高管和律师有时会帮忙掩盖。

sentences.en: In other cases, chose to look the other way.
sentences.zh: 在其他情况下，选择视而不见。

sentences.en: There were relationships with those in politics that he used to his advantage.
sentences.zh: 他还与政界人士保持着关系，并以此为自己谋取利益。

sentences.en: Our reporting really aimed to sort of go deeper on those relationships and see the role that they served as he carried on with his predatory behavior for decades.
sentences.zh: 我们的报道确实旨在深入探讨这些关系，并了解在他数十年来继续实施掠夺性行为时，它们所起到的作用。

sentences.en: I want you to walk us through each of those, but let's start within Weinstein's own company,
sentences.zh: 我想请你带我们逐一了解这些，但让我们先从韦恩斯坦自己的公司开始，

sentences.en: because so many of these alleged assaults took place within the confines of work.
sentences.zh: 因为许多所谓的袭击都发生在工作场所内。

sentences.en: What have you learned in this new reporting about just how unusual it was to work at this company?
sentences.zh: 关于在这家公司工作究竟有多不寻常，你们在这篇新报道中了解到了什么？

sentences.en: Even though it wasn't visible to everybody at the time, Harvey Weinstein was able to kind of engineer both of his companies
sentences.zh: 尽管当时并非所有人都能看到，但哈维·韦恩斯坦能够精心策划他的两家公司，

sentences.en: to facilitate and to cover up his behavior.
sentences.zh: 以促成和掩盖他的行为。

sentences.en: And that was true at the highest levels, and it was true at the lowest levels.
sentences.zh: 最高层如此，最底层也是如此。

sentences.en: Harvey Weinstein had many, many, many assistants over the years.
sentences.zh: 多年来，哈维·韦恩斯坦有过多位、多位、多位助理。

sentences.en: People describe him even having four or five assistants at a time.
sentences.zh: 人们甚至形容他同时有四五个助理。

sentences.en: And some of them are accused of really being on the front lines of what happened.
sentences.zh: 其中一些人被指控实际上处于所发生事情的最前线。

sentences.en: They had to not only arrange encounters with women, but there were versions of this thing called the Bible,
sentences.zh: 他们不仅要安排与女性的会面，而且还有一种名为“圣经”的东西的各种版本，

sentences.en: which was kind of, you know, the how to be Harvey Weinstein's assistant book.
sentences.zh: 这可以说是，你知道的，如何成为哈维·韦恩斯坦助理的指南书。

sentences.en: There were lots of different versions of it over the years.
sentences.zh: 多年来，它有过很多不同的版本。

sentences.en: But some of the Bibles also had these kinds of hints on facilitation.
sentences.zh: 但其中一些“圣经”也包含这类协助的暗示。

sentences.en: They would say things like, if Mr. Weinstein's wife calls, be a gatekeeper, meaning be polite, but don't give her too much information about where Mr. Weinstein is.
sentences.zh: 他们会说这样的话：如果韦恩斯坦夫人的电话打来，要做一个守门人，意思是保持礼貌，但不要向她透露太多关于韦恩斯坦先生在哪里的信息。

sentences.en: Now, eventually, there was something else that was entered into the Bible, which is instructions on how to procure for Harvey Weinstein a certain kind of medication
sentences.zh: 后来，“圣经”中又加入了另一项内容，那就是关于如何为哈维·韦恩斯坦采购某种药物的说明，

sentences.en: that seems to have played a role in his sexual activities.
sentences.zh: 这种药物似乎在他的性活动中发挥了作用。

sentences.en: And what do you mean by that?
sentences.zh: 你这话是什么意思？

sentences.en: What kind of medication?
sentences.zh: 什么药？

sentences.en: So, he relied, it appears pretty heavily, based on the description of some assistants, on medication that men use for erectile dysfunction.
sentences.zh: 根据一些助理的描述，他似乎相当依赖男性用于治疗勃起功能障碍的药物。

sentences.en: This medication is injected directly into the penis.
sentences.zh: 这种药物直接注射到阴茎中。

sentences.en: And assistants had to procure it for him.
sentences.zh: 助理们必须为他采购。

sentences.en: They had to keep it at their desk sometimes, and they had to deliver it to him.
sentences.zh: 有时他们必须把它放在办公桌上，还必须把它送给他。

sentences.en: Sometimes they even had to clean up the dispensers.
sentences.zh: 有时他们甚至不得不清理分配器。

sentences.en: And if assistants protested any of these highly unusual tasks that you're describing, that very much seemed to facilitate this behavior, what would happen to them?
sentences.zh: 如果助理们对你所描述的这些高度不同寻常、似乎极大地助长了这种行为的任务提出抗议，他们会遭遇什么？

sentences.en: Well, one of the assistants we talked to, her name is Michelle Franklin, she's from the UK,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们交谈过的一位助理，她叫米歇尔·富兰克林，来自英国，

sentences.en: and she confronted him about, she said she was just really uncomfortable with what she was asked to do.
sentences.zh: 她质问过他，她说她对被要求做的事情感到非常不舒服。

sentences.en: And she was fired shortly thereafter.
sentences.zh: 不久之后她就被解雇了。

sentences.en: So, the message was, if you want to rise in the film industry, you have to put up with this stuff, and you have to do it, and I am in charge of your fate.
sentences.zh: 所以传达的信息是，如果你想在电影界晋升，你必须忍受这些东西，你必须照做，而我掌控着你的命运。

sentences.en: I was 26 years old when I started working at the Weinstein Company.
sentences.zh: 我开始在韦恩斯坦公司工作时才26岁。

sentences.en: Lauren O'Connor began working at the Weinstein Company in 2013.
sentences.zh: 劳伦·奥康纳于2013年开始在韦恩斯坦公司工作。

sentences.en: I'd been working as a literary scout, finding literary material to option and adapt for, you know, features or television shows.
sentences.zh: 我一直在做文学星探，寻找可以买下版权并改编成故事片或电视节目的文学素材。

sentences.en: This was the company that was able to take something as literary and sprawling as, say, the English patient, and turn it into an Oscar winner.
sentences.zh: 这家公司能够把像《英国病人》这样具有文学性和庞大体量的作品，变成奥斯卡奖得主。

sentences.en: I mean, that was the dream.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那是梦想。

sentences.en: So, in the case of Lauren O'Connor, she was a junior executive at the company,
sentences.zh: 因此，就劳伦·奥康纳而言，她是公司的初级高管，

sentences.en: and as she tells it, slowly by surely, she's starting to piece together the puzzle of Weinstein's behavior, and she's very troubled by it.
sentences.zh: 据她讲述，她渐渐地开始拼凑出韦恩斯坦行为的谜团，这让她非常不安。

sentences.en: It became clear to me that many of the meetings that we were asked to schedule were not of a professional nature.
sentences.zh: 我很清楚，我们被要求安排的许多会议都不是专业性质的。

sentences.en: At their best, employees were used to set dates.
sentences.zh: 往好了说，员工被用来安排约会。

sentences.en: And at their worst, without knowledge, they were used to do something much more terrible.
sentences.zh: 往坏了说，在不知情的情况下，他们被用来做更糟糕的事情。

sentences.en: And her first step is to go to Human Resources for help.
sentences.zh: 她的第一步是去找人力资源部门寻求帮助。

sentences.en: And as she tells it, you know, when she did that, she reported that she was frightened to travel with Harvey Weinstein,
sentences.zh: 据她讲述，你知道，当她这样做时，她报告说她害怕和哈维·韦恩斯坦一起出差，

sentences.en: and the response was basically, let us know if he hits you or crosses a line physically.
sentences.zh: 而得到的回复基本上是：如果他打了你或者在身体上越界了，请告诉我们。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: And, yeah, so then, and, you know, so she continues to...
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，所以然后，你知道的，所以她继续……

sentences.en: So they're raising the bar, saying, unless he hits you, we don't really want to know much about it.
sentences.zh: 所以他们提高了门槛，意思是，除非他打了你，否则我们其实不想知道太多。

sentences.en: And so she, in 2015, she submits a detailed memo outlining a variety of allegations of sexual harassment
sentences.zh: 因此，在2015年，她提交了一份详细的备忘录，概述了对韦恩斯坦的各种性骚扰指控

sentences.en: and other misconduct by Weinstein, and includes what the response had been earlier when she had gone to HR.
sentences.zh: 以及其他不当行为，并附上了她先前去人力资源部时得到的回复。

sentences.en: And, you know, at that point, Human Resources stepped aside and the lawyer stepped in.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，当时人力资源部退居幕后，律师介入了。

sentences.en: I became a problem that needed to go away.
sentences.zh: 我成了一个必须消失的麻烦。

sentences.en: You know, the irony is I was trying to flag problematic behavior, and instead I became the problem.
sentences.zh: 你知道，讽刺的是，我试图指出有问题的行为，结果我却成了问题本身。

sentences.en: The settlements that we uncovered with Weinstein going back to 1990,
sentences.zh: 我们发现的韦恩斯坦可以追溯到1990年的和解协议，

sentences.en: these are all out-of-court settlements in which lawyers sort of swoop in after a woman comes forward with an allegation,
sentences.zh: 这些都是庭外和解，律师在女性提出指控后迅速介入，

sentences.en: and they quietly strike a legally binding agreement in which the woman receives financial compensation and, in exchange, is required to never speak of her accusation ever again.
sentences.zh: 他们悄悄达成了一项具有法律约束力的协议，女性获得经济赔偿，作为交换，被要求永远不再谈论她的指控。

sentences.en: This is really getting at the nature of these confidential agreements.
sentences.zh: 这确实触及了这些保密协议的本质。

sentences.en: It is, in many ways, impossible to piece together exactly what happened with them behind the scenes because everybody is legally bound to secrecy.
sentences.zh: 在许多情况下，根本不可能拼凑出幕后究竟发生了什么，因为每个人都在法律上受到保密的约束。

sentences.en: Okay, I want to switch gears out of the confines of Weinstein's companies.
sentences.zh: 好的，我想换个话题，不再局限于韦恩斯坦公司的内部。

sentences.en: How did he avoid ever being exposed by the media, especially the Hollywood media, the tabloids, which cover him and this industry so closely?
sentences.zh: 他是如何避免被媒体，尤其是密切关注他和这个行业的好莱坞媒体、小报彻底曝光的？

sentences.en: If so many people seem to know about this, how did it not come out in the tabloids?
sentences.zh: 如果这么多人似乎都知道这件事，为什么小报没有爆出来呢？

sentences.en: The question of Harvey's relationship with the media is a fascinating one, and it's clear that he held off press scrutiny with a mix of threats and enticements.
sentences.zh: 关于哈维与媒体的关系是一个迷人的问题，很显然，他通过威胁和诱惑并用的手段阻止了媒体的审视。

sentences.en: You know, when it comes to tabloids, one of the most fascinating relationships was the one that Harvey had with David Pecker,
sentences.zh: 你知道，说到小报，最迷人的一段关系就是哈维与大卫·佩克的关系，

sentences.en: who was the chief executive of America Media Incorporated, which is the parent company to the National Enquirer, where he was known internally as an untouchable FOP,
sentences.zh: 他是美国媒体公司（National Enquirer的母公司）的首席执行官，他在公司内部被称为“不可触碰的FOP”，

sentences.en: a friend of Pecker, the chief executive.
sentences.zh: 即首席执行官佩克的朋友（Friend of Pecker）。

sentences.en: And not only did the National Enquirer not cover Weinstein, but what our colleague Jim Rutenberg was able to discover was that it actually,
sentences.zh: 《国民问询报》不仅没有报道韦恩斯坦，而且我们的同事吉姆·鲁滕伯格发现的是，事实上，

sentences.en: behind the scenes, helped work to dig up information on Harvey's female accusers and giving it to him.
sentences.zh: 它在幕后协助挖掘有关哈维女性指控者的信息并提供给他。

sentences.en: And, you know, when we were doing our final round of fact-checking and seeking comment,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，当我们进行最后一轮事实核查和寻求置评时，

sentences.en: American media admitted to that.
sentences.zh: 美国媒体承认了这一点。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: What exactly did they admit to?
sentences.zh: 他们到底承认了什么？

sentences.en: They admitted that, yes, they acknowledged that the company occasionally worked to gather information to help Harvey Weinstein because of mutual business interests.
sentences.zh: 他们承认，是的，他们承认该公司由于共同的商业利益，偶尔会收集信息来帮助哈维·韦恩斯坦。

sentences.en: And they said, quote, to the extent that AMI provided off-the-record information to Mr. Weinstein about his accusers,
sentences.zh: 他们说，引述：“至于美国媒体公司向韦恩斯坦先生提供关于其指控者的非记录在案的信息，

sentences.en: it did so at a time when Mr. Weinstein was denying any harassment.
sentences.zh: 那是在韦恩斯坦先生否认任何骚扰的时候进行的。”

sentences.en: So let's say that another tabloid, maybe one where Weinstein doesn't have a friend running things or a formal business relationship, were to get wind of a story about his behavior.
sentences.zh: 那么，假设另一家小报，也许是一家韦恩斯坦没有朋友掌权或没有正式业务关系的小报，风闻了一篇关于他的行为的报道。

sentences.en: How would Weinstein stop them, perhaps, from publishing?
sentences.zh: 韦恩斯坦会如何阻止他们发表呢？

sentences.en: So Weinstein exploited a long-standing system of favor-trading between the press and the movie business.
sentences.zh: 因此，韦恩斯坦利用了媒体与电影界之间长期存在的利益交换系统。

sentences.en: You know, gossip readers need a steady stream of juicy tidbits, and industry beat reporters need exclusives on the next big deal.
sentences.zh: 你知道，八卦读者需要源源不断的多汁八卦，而行业突发新闻记者则需要关于下一个重大交易的独家新闻。

sentences.en: And Weinstein, you know, he wanted glowing coverage, and he could provide what they needed and more.
sentences.zh: 而韦恩斯坦，你知道的，他想要赞誉有加的报道，他可以提供他们需要的东西以及更多。

sentences.en: And so he, sometimes working with others, including A.J.
sentences.zh: 因此，他有时会与其他人合作，包括A.J.

sentences.en: Benza, a gossip, former gossip columnist, who says that he was paid thousands of dollars by Weinstein
sentences.zh: 本扎，一位八卦记者、前八卦专栏作家，他称韦恩斯坦付给他数千美元，

sentences.en: to basically come up with juicy celebrity gossip that Harvey could deploy in his efforts
sentences.zh: 基本上就是让他炮制有趣的明星八卦，好让哈维用来讨好小报，

sentences.en: to kind of keep the tabloids happy and deflect any attention, negative attention, on him himself.
sentences.zh: 并转移任何对准他自己的负面注意力。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So, in a sense, Weinstein is generating his own material to barter with tabloids,
sentences.zh: 所以，从某种意义上说，韦恩斯坦在生成自己的素材，以便与小报、

sentences.en: with celebrity news publications that might prevent them from publishing something unflattering about him.
sentences.zh: 与名人新闻出版物进行交换，从而阻止他们发表对他不利的报道。

sentences.en: That's exactly what he was doing.
sentences.zh: 他当时就是这么做的。

sentences.en: So these members of the media explicitly offered Weinstein cover by agreeing to bury these stories or barter their way out of them.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些媒体成员通过同意掩盖这些报道或以此作为交换条件，明确为韦恩斯坦提供了庇护。

sentences.en: But there were others who offered him a different kind of a cover, right?
sentences.zh: 但还有其他人向他提供了另一种庇护，对吧？

sentences.en: Well, Harvey Weinstein was a master of leverage.
sentences.zh: 嗯，哈维·韦恩斯坦是操纵杠杆的大师。

sentences.en: He parlayed his films into relationships in New York and Washington and Los Angeles, and then he parlayed those relationships into even more things.
sentences.zh: 他把自己的电影转化为在纽约、华盛顿和洛杉矶的关系，然后他又将这些关系转化为更多的东西。

sentences.en: Probably his most important and closest relationship with a politician has been with Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 他与政客最重要、最亲密的关系可能就是与希拉里·克林顿的关系。

sentences.en: So I'd rather go with Hillary, who's a, you know, strong, proven leader.
sentences.zh: 所以我更倾向于选择希拉里，她是一个坚强、经验丰富的领袖。

sentences.en: And the world's crazy right now.
sentences.zh: 现在这个世界太疯狂了。

sentences.en: We need that strong hand.
sentences.zh: 我们需要强有力的人来掌控。

sentences.en: He was in on her career from the very beginning.
sentences.zh: 他从一开始就参与了她的政治生涯。

sentences.en: He played an important role in her Senate campaign, and the relationship only grew from there.
sentences.zh: 他在她的参议院竞选活动中发挥了重要作用，这种关系从那以后不断加深。

sentences.en: But Harvey's here.
sentences.zh: 但哈维在这里。

sentences.en: Harvey is supporting Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 哈维在支持希拉里·克林顿。

sentences.en: And you have raised money as well.
sentences.zh: 你也在筹款。

sentences.en: Yes, you've raised money.
sentences.zh: 是的，你筹集了资金。

sentences.en: I have raised money, and I think the whole thing about Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 我筹集了资金，我认为关于希拉里·克林顿的整件事……

sentences.en: He continued both in the 2008 and 2016 presidential campaigns.
sentences.zh: 他在2008年和2016年的总统竞选活动中都延续了这一点。

sentences.en: He was able to raise a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 他能够筹集到大量资金。

sentences.en: He was able to bring celebrity firepower.
sentences.zh: 他能够带来名人的强大影响力。

sentences.en: Clinton pulled in something in the neighborhood of 1.8 million.
sentences.zh: 克林顿筹集了大约180万美元。

sentences.en: That alone is more than the 1.3 million that the Donald Trump campaign reported having on here.
sentences.zh: 仅此一项就超过了唐纳德·特朗普竞选团队报告拥有的130万美元。

sentences.en: And then in the 2016 campaign, the writer and creator and actor, Lena Dunham, gave what she says was a pretty strong warning to the Clinton campaign.
sentences.zh: 然后在2016年的竞选活动中，作家、创作者兼演员莉娜·邓汉姆向克林顿竞选团队发出了她所说的相当严厉的警告。

sentences.en: She said she went to Christina Shockey, who is the deputy communications director, and also one other aide a few months later.
sentences.zh: 她说她找到了副通信总监克里斯蒂娜·肖基，几个月后又找到了另一位助手。

sentences.en: And she said that she said things in no uncertain terMs.
sentences.zh: 她说她用毫不含糊的词眼表达了这一点。

sentences.en: She even used the word rapist to describe Harvey Weinstein.
sentences.zh: 她甚至用了“强奸犯”这个词来形容哈维·韦恩斯坦。

sentences.en: And so we tried to figure out what happened after that, whether it was ever run up the flagpole.
sentences.zh: 所以我们试图弄清楚那之后发生了什么，这是否曾被上报给高层。

sentences.en: What we can definitely tell you is that Harvey Weinstein not only stayed involved in Hillary
sentences.zh: 我们绝对可以告诉你的是，哈维·韦恩斯坦不仅一直参与希拉里

sentences.en: Clinton's 2016 presidential bid until the very end, but they stayed close until after the election.
sentences.zh: 克林顿2016年的总统竞选直到最后，而且他们直到选举结束后依然保持密切联系。

sentences.en: They had dinner shortly thereafter.
sentences.zh: 不久之后他们还一起共进晚餐。

sentences.en: And also, one thing we were kind of startled to find out is that just a few days before we broke
sentences.zh: 另外，让我们感到震惊的一件事是，就在我们爆出

sentences.en: the Harvey Weinstein story, we found evidence that Harvey Weinstein and Hillary Clinton were still working on a TV show project together.
sentences.zh: 哈维·韦恩斯坦丑闻的前几天，我们发现证据表明哈维·韦恩斯坦和希拉里·克林顿仍在合作一个电视剧项目。

sentences.en: And we found that the project was only really canceled after the allegations came out.
sentences.zh: 我们发现该项目直到指控曝光后才真正被取消。

sentences.en: So despite warnings by people who had the Clintons' interest at heart,
sentences.zh: 因此，尽管把克林顿利益放在心上的人发出了警告，

sentences.en: Weinstein's relationship with Hillary Clinton and perhaps his sway or a combination of those two things was such that the campaign maintained close ties to him,
sentences.zh: 韦恩斯坦与希拉里·克林顿的关系，或许还有他的影响力，或者是这两者的结合，使得竞选团队与他保持着紧密的联系，

sentences.en: even as people were telling Hillary Clinton's political operation, stay away from him.
sentences.zh: 尽管当时人们一直在告诉希拉里·克林顿的政治团队：离他远点。

sentences.en: That's correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And by the way, one way of understanding how deep these ties go is knowing that back when President Clinton was facing legal trouble for his treatment of Monica Lewinsky,
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，要理解这些联系有多深，有一种方法就是知道，早在克林顿总统因对待莫妮卡·莱温斯基而面临法律麻烦时，

sentences.en: Harvey Weinstein donated $10,000, which was the legal maximum, to the former president's legal defense fund.
sentences.zh: 哈维·韦恩斯坦就向这位前总统的法律辩护基金捐赠了1万美元，这是当时法律规定的最高额度。

sentences.en: So Harvey Weinstein helped Bill Clinton, Hillary Clinton's husband, weather his own allegations of sexual misconduct.
sentences.zh: 因此，哈维·韦恩斯坦帮助希拉里·克林顿的丈夫比尔·克林顿度过了他自己的性骚扰指控危机。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I was just sick.
sentences.zh: 我当时只觉得恶心。

sentences.en: I was shocked.
sentences.zh: 我很震惊。

sentences.en: I was appalled.
sentences.zh: 我感到骇然。

sentences.en: You know, like so many people who have come forward and spoken out, this was a different side of a person who I and many others had known in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像许多站出来发声的人一样，这是我过去以及许多其他人所认识的一个人的另一面。

sentences.en: Would you have called him a friend?
sentences.zh: 你会称他为朋友吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I probably would have.
sentences.zh: 是的，我大概会这么叫。

sentences.en: So a Clinton spokesman gave us a statement and he said, we were shocked when we learned what he'd done.
sentences.zh: 所以克林顿的一位发言人发表了一份声明，他说，当我们得知他所做的事情时，我们感到震惊。

sentences.en: It's despicable behavior and the women that have come forward have shown enormous courage.
sentences.zh: 这是卑鄙的行为，站出来指控的女性展现出了巨大的勇气。

sentences.en: They said that the staff would not have forgotten the kind of warning that Lena Dunham gave.
sentences.zh: 他们说，工作人员不会忘记莉娜·邓纳姆给出的那种警告。

sentences.en: And then curiously, they said, I want to read you this sentence because it's kind of interesting.
sentences.zh: 接着奇怪的是，他们说，我想把这句话读给你听，因为它有点意思。

sentences.en: They said, only she, meaning Lena Dunham, can answer why she would tell them instead of those who could stop him.
sentences.zh: 他们说，只有她（指的是莉娜·邓纳姆）能回答，为什么她要把这件事告诉他们，而不是告诉那些能够阻止他的人。

sentences.en: So what you're describing, it's hard to see this as anything other than a man strategically creating an ecosystem
sentences.zh: 所以你所描述的，很难不让人把这看作是一个男人在精心构建一个生态系统，

sentences.en: designed to allow him to sexually assault and continue to sexually assault women for decades.
sentences.zh: 旨在让他得以对女性进行性侵犯，并长达几十年持续进行性侵犯。

sentences.en: That's certainly what it looks like when we piece things together in retrospect.
sentences.zh: 当我们事后把事情拼凑起来时，看起来确实是这样的。

sentences.en: You know, the thing we really want to emphasize about this whole story, Michael, is that we're not putting the emphasis on any one or two individuals.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，迈克尔，关于整个故事，我们真正想要强调的是，我们并没有把重点放在某一个或两个个人身上。

sentences.en: We really felt that what we were writing was a story of collective failure.
sentences.zh: 我们真心觉得，我们所写的是一个集体失职的故事。

sentences.en: How could so many different people at so many levels either miss signals or fail to ask questions or fail to speak up or fail to heed warnings?
sentences.zh: 为什么在各个层面的这么多人，要么忽视信号，要么不愿提问，要么不发声，要么不听取警告？

sentences.en: Why did people fail to act?
sentences.zh: 为什么人们没有采取行动？

sentences.en: It's very easy to look back at the Harvey Weinstein story and say, of course, more people should have intervened.
sentences.zh: 回顾哈维·韦恩斯坦的故事时，人们很容易说，当然应该有更多的人进行干预。

sentences.en: More people should have acted.
sentences.zh: 应该有更多的人采取行动。

sentences.en: This was a massive collective failure involving many, many, many people.
sentences.zh: 这是一个涉及许许多多人的巨大的集体失职事件。

sentences.en: But in the course of reporting the story, I thought that some of the most fascinating conversations we had with sources
sentences.zh: 但在报道这个故事的过程中，我发现我们与消息源进行的一些最精彩的对话，

sentences.en: were conversations in which they asked themselves, well, what exactly should I have done?
sentences.zh: 是他们在对话中反问自己：好吧，我到底本该做些什么？

sentences.en: How could I have stopped this?
sentences.zh: 我本该如何阻止这一切？

sentences.en: Jody and Megan, thank you both for making time.
sentences.zh: 乔迪和梅根，非常感谢两位拨冗前来。

sentences.en: Thanks for having us.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我们。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: So please allow me to summarize these decisions.
sentences.zh: 所以请允许我总结一下这些决定。

sentences.en: The Russian Olympic Committee is suspended with immediate effect.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯奥林匹克委员会被即刻禁赛。

sentences.en: After an extensive investigation, the International Olympic Committee is barring Russia from competing in the 2018 Winter Olympics
sentences.zh: 经过广泛调查，国际奥林匹克委员会禁止俄罗斯参加2018年冬季奥运会，

sentences.en: as punishment for a government-backed program of systematically doping its athletes.
sentences.zh: 作为对其政府支持的系统性实施运动员兴奋剂计划的惩罚。

sentences.en: Among its findings, the Olympic Committee said that during the 2014 Winter Games,
sentences.zh: 奥委会的调查结果显示，在2014年冬奥会期间，

sentences.en: Russia's sports ministry tampered with more than 100 urine samples to conceal top athletes' use of steroids throughout the competition.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯体育部篡改了100多份尿样，以掩盖顶级运动员在整个比赛期间使用类固醇的行为。

sentences.en: Individual, clean Russian athletes will be able to participate under strict conditions at the Olympic Winter Games,
sentences.zh: 符合资格且清白的俄罗斯运动员将在严格的条件下参加奥林匹克冬季运动会，

sentences.en: Pyeongchang 2018.
sentences.zh: 2018年平昌冬奥会。

sentences.en: Athletes from Russia who receive special permission to compete will do so as independent athletes wearing a neutral uniform.
sentences.zh: 获得特殊参赛许可的俄罗斯运动员将作为独立运动员参赛，身着中立制服。

sentences.en: And the official record books will show that Russia won zero medals.
sentences.zh: 官方记录将显示俄罗斯获得了零枚奖牌。

sentences.en: These invited athletes will participate, be it in individual or team competitions, under the name Olympic Athlete from Russia, with the acronym OAR.
sentences.zh: 这些受邀的运动员将以“俄罗斯奥运队”的名义（缩写为OAR）参加个人或团体比赛。

sentences.en: They will compete with the uniform bearing this name and under the Olympic flag.
sentences.zh: 他们将身着印有该名称的制服，并在奥林匹克旗下参赛。

sentences.en: The Olympic anthem will be played in any ceremony.
sentences.zh: 任何颁奖仪式上都将奏响奥林匹克会歌。

sentences.en: And I am retiring today.
sentences.zh: 我今天宣布退休。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, Representative John Conyers of Michigan called into a local radio show in Detroit to announce that he is leaving Congress immediately.
sentences.zh: 周二，来自密歇根州的联邦众议员约翰·康耶斯致到底特律的一档地方广播节目，宣布他将立即辞去国会议员职务。

sentences.en: Conyers had been facing intense pressure to resign after allegations that he sexually harassed multiple former employees,
sentences.zh: 在面临多名前员工对其进行性骚扰指控后，康耶斯一直承受着巨大的辞职压力，

sentences.en: charges that he continued to deny on Tuesday in announcing his retirement.
sentences.zh: 他在周二宣布退休时继续否认这些指控。

sentences.en: Whatever they are, they are not accurate or they're not true.
sentences.zh: 无论这些指控是什么，它们都不准确或不真实。

sentences.en: Conyers was the longest-serving member of the House and the longest-serving African American in its history.
sentences.zh: 康耶斯是众议院任职时间最长的成员，也是其历史上任职时间最长的非裔美国人。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 今天的《每日新闻》就到这里。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《割草机秀》将为我们带来如何为假期接待客人做好准备的内容。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是沾床就睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是不省人事才睡着。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们爱喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用或你喜欢的任何播客平台上搜索《割草机秀》。
